title: Numbing cream for Earrings
description:
﻿How to Apply for Earlobes

  1. ​Clean the Area: Wash your earlobes with mild soap and water, then pat them dry.
  2. ​Apply a Thin Layer: Use a cotton swab to apply a small amount of the gel to the front and back of the earlobe where the piercing sits.
  3. ​Wait for Effect: It typically takes 5 to 15 minutes for the numbing effect to kick in. You will feel a slight tingling or "dead" sensation in the skin.
  4. ​Wipe Before Inserting: Gently wipe away any excess gel with a clean tissue before putting your earrings in to prevent the gel from getting into the piercing track or on your jewelry.

title: Noor kundan Chandbalis
description:
These exquisite earrings feature a fusion of Kundan-style stonework and a regal Chandbali silhouette, centered by a striking triangular mirror element.

​The intricate gold-toned plating is beautifully accented by a cascade of ivory pearls, adding a soft, vintage charm to the bold design.

​Perfect for weddings or festive occasions, these jhumkas offer a grand, royal aesthetic that effortlessly elevates any traditional ethnic outfit.

title: Royal Floral Chandbali Jhumkas
description:
​Traditional Design: These statement earrings feature a classic Chandbali (half-moon) silhouette combined with intricate floral motifs.

​Elegant Detailing: The piece is embellished with shining Kundan-style mirror work and delicate white seed beads that outline the central floral patterns.﻿

​Pearlescent Finish: The bottom is finished with a graceful fringe of polished cream-colored pearls that add movement and a touch of vintage charm.﻿

​Versatile Glamour: Designed as "Fashion Earrings," they are a bold accessory perfect for weddings, festivals, or elevating ethnic attire.﻿
